rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Product designer for AI applications and client projects, working across user research, product ideation, UX, and UI design. The role is the team's first full-time designer and includes independent design work on new products. The role starts as a three-month contract intended to convert to permanent full-time employment.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of product design experience in a professional environment.
- Experience designing AI applications.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Previous consulting or contracting experience juggling multiple projects.
- Startup experience.
- Experience designing products and features independently.
- Experience with Next.js apps in product design.
- Ability to collaborate directly with engineers to get designs implemented and understand what is possible.
- Experience using Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code to create mock-ups and interactive designs.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Continental United States (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
